leaves.name: y3FineModuliAb
leaves.doc: y3abu-print, printed form (representability, one object: the fine moduli scheme Y3 with its universal family): the polarization-free moduli problem of abelian surfaces with an action of the maximal order O of B = (2,-3|Q) and full level-3 structure (level H = K3) is represented over Q by a proper smooth curve (some (Y, Phi) satisfies R1fpPropsAb). Polarization-free prints (recalled): Boutot-Carayol, Asterisque 196-197 (1991) ch. III section 1; Buzzard, Duke Math. J. 87 (1997) section 1; PEL prints: Deligne 1971 Ex. 5.8, Milne 1979; locators UNVERIFIED. Consequence form: universal property used on proper smooth curve bases and read on field points; base Q. y3abu-strict: if only a PEL (polarized) print is confirmed, the passage is the relative Lemma P over proper smooth curves over Q, which cannot be stated in Lean today (no dual abelian scheme or polarization over a base) and the leaf counts GLUE; Lemma P's lattice core is compiled (Y3ABUStrict.LemmaP.lemmaP_lattice_unique).
leaves.flag: locator UNVERIFIED: the polarization-free form at level K3 (full level 3, 3 | disc B) is to be confirmed in Boutot-Carayol ch. III section 1 or Buzzard 1997 section 1
leaves.source: Boutot-Carayol, Uniformisation p-adique des courbes de Shimura, Asterisque 196-197 (1991) ch. III section 1 (polarization-free moduli of abelian surfaces with O_B-action and level H, representable for H small); Buzzard, Integral models of certain Shimura curves, Duke Math. J. 87 (1997) section 1; base Q, H = K3; locators UNVERIFIED

leaves.name: deligneModuliY3Every
leaves.doc: y3abu-strict, printed form (moduli interpretation, one object: Y3(C) with its complex uniformization, no Galois action): on every fine witness (Y, Phi) there is Psi : H x (B tensor A_f)^x -> Y(C), onto, with fibres the B^x_+ \ . / K3 classes (DCRel), holomorphic in tau, whose value at (tau, u), u in O-hat^x, is the QM torus C^2/iota(O)(tau,1)^T with its level structure eta(a) = (1/3) iota(a w)(tau,1)^T, w = u^-1 mod 3 (ModuliLevelAtUnits). Boutot-Carayol ch. III section 1 (complex points of M_H, polarization-free); Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties section 8 and Deligne 1971 section 4 (PEL form); Shimura 1967 sections 2-3; locators UNVERIFIED. Consequence form: H with B^x_+ for H^+- with B^x; moduli clause at O-hat^x (determines Psi with DCRel and class number one); bijective and holomorphic in place of biholomorphic. Every-witness form = one-witness form (Y3ABUStrict.deligneModuliY3Every_of_one). From a PEL print, the step is Lemma P over C (lattice core compiled) and the comparison Y_C = M_C.
leaves.flag: locator UNVERIFIED: the polarization-free form of the complex uniformization of M_K3 is to be confirmed in Boutot-Carayol ch. III section 1; Milne ISV section 8 and Deligne 1971 section 4 print the PEL form
leaves.source: Boutot-Carayol, Asterisque 196-197 (1991) ch. III section 1; Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) section 8; Deligne, Travaux de Shimura, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) section 4; Shimura, Ann. of Math. 85 (1967) sections 2-3; at B = (2,-3|Q), level K3; locators UNVERIFIED

leaves.name: deligneReciprocityY3Every
leaves.doc: y3abu-strict, printed form (canonical-model property, one object: Y3 with the Galois action on its CM points; no existence claim): on every fine witness (Y, Phi), every Psi with the moduli interpretation (ModuliInterpAt, level structure pinned) satisfies Shimura's reciprocity law at CM points, sigma Psi(z, g) = Psi(z, q-hat(s)^eps g) for sigma = [s, K] on K^ab (conventions eps, delta existential). Deligne, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) sections 4-5, Cor. 5.7 / Ex. 5.8 (the PEL moduli scheme with its moduli interpretation is the canonical model); Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties section 14; Shimura 1967 Main Theorem I; locators UNVERIFIED. Consequence form: specialized to the CM points of imaginary quadratic K, read through Phi (only the forgetful direction polarized -> polarization-free objects is used, so no Lemma P). Every-witness form = one-witness form (Y3ABUStrict.deligneReciprocityY3Every_of_one).
leaves.flag: locator UNVERIFIED: Deligne 1971 Cor. 5.7 / Ex. 5.8 read by the locator audit (locators.md R1) for the PEL model over E(G,h); its specialization to B = (2,-3|Q), K3, E(G,h) = Q not checked against the print
leaves.source: Deligne, Travaux de Shimura, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) sections 4-5 (Cor. 5.7, Ex. 5.8); Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) section 14; Shimura, Ann. of Math. 85 (1967) Main Theorem I; at B = (2,-3|Q), level K3; locators UNVERIFIED
